$comment: Site Converter deterministic (no-AI) coverage map. One row per SOURCE SURFACE -> its detector/recognizer, its builder, its recognizer priority (if any), and status. Derived from the deterministic-converter audit (D:/claude-backup/reports/deterministic-converter-audit.md, 2026-08-06). Purpose: make coverage + gaps/orphans VISIBLE and greppable so a recognizer/mapper change can't silently drop a mapping. Keep in sync when recognizers/builders change; the golden-fixture test (tests/freshpaws-golden-test.php) is the runtime guard. Status legend: MAPPED = native shortcode/setting emitted; PARTIAL = handled but lossy / verbatim code_block fallback; MISSING = no handler, falls through to flatten/code_block; ORPHAN = builder exists but no recognizer feeds it.

chrome_header.note: P2 fidelity enrichment (BEATS the hand-built demo, which used a flat text logo): an icon-CHIP + two-tone wordmark lockup is now fully reproduced. detect_logo captures the leading `bg-primary rounded-2xl` chip (its bg/size/radius -> logo_icon_frame squircle + logo_icon_frame_bg) with the paw Paws` (theme prints site_title RAW inside .site-title-text) with a scoped logo_custom_css painting `.accent` the brand green. Tight: only builds the lockup when a real leading icon-chip precedes the wordmark; a plain text/image logo stays as-is (negative control in golden test). PHP<->JS parity: capture-extract logoDetail.title_accent_text + to-theme-settings split emit. Guarded by golden test [3] (site_title two-tone split, chip bg green, paw markup, squircle) + plain-logo negative control.

chrome_header.builder: header_layout.header_mode / header_behavior / header_glass / header_shadow / header_border / header_design

chrome_footer.note:
P2 fidelity enrichment (BEATS the hand-built demo, which flattened 4 footer columns to 2): every populated column of the source grid is kept in order (link columns, text-item columns like 'Services', and a CONTACT column) instead of capping at 2. A column whose
  • rows are predominantly icon+text is classified kind='contact' and routed to a native leading-icon list (footer_contact_row): each row keeps its leading
    — no more 'LaneSpringfield' glue). PHP<->JS parity: capture-extract footer.contact rows + to-design-config passthrough + to-theme-settings contact emit. Guarded by golden test (Contact column: 3 fw-ci-icon rows, green tint, map-pin present, address
    preserved; 4-col footer stays 4; 2-col footer negative control stays 2).

P2: the brand column's rounded-full social circles (`bg-white/10 rounded-full` anchors wrapping an svg, often href='#') are recognised by ICON class/aria (social_network_of) so placeholder hrefs still map -> 3 social_profiles (fb/ig/tw) on the FreshPaws footer. PHP<->JS parity: capture-extract social.net (icon-network sniff) + to-design-config keeps net-only socials + to-theme-settings NET_LUCIDE fallback. Guarded by golden test (3 profiles from 3 rounded-full anchors).

sections_body.note: P1 fidelity fix (audit: 'hero pill emits empty pill_color + leading_icon:none'). pill_parts now captures the container's computed style (pillCs) AND a leading inline <svg> before the text (leadingSvg, data-sc-* stripped). n_announcement_pill sets pill_color from the container's REAL computed background — a semantic `bg-primary/10` tint resolves via data-sc-cs to rgba(33,196,93,.1) which the Tailwind class-compiler can't (helper pill_fill_color keeps low-alpha fills, drops transparent) — and carries the leading svg into leading_icon (type:svg, same mechanism as the heading overline_icon), setting leading:icon. TIGHT: a pill with no real fill keeps pill_color empty; a pill with no leading svg keeps leading:none. Guarded by golden test [11] (hero pill → rgba(33,196,93,.1) + leading svg; plain-pill negative control). JS twin: the URL path renders the hero pill via the heading OVERLINE (overline_container:pill + overline_icon + overline_color), which already carries the leading svg + fill (capture-extract overline ovIcon/color/bg).

Icon-chip capture (fidelity-audit P0): card_from_cell now carries the leading inline <svg>'s OWN color classes (iconCls: text-primary/text-secondary) AND its filled chip wrapper (iconChipCls: e.g. `w-16 h-16 bg-white rounded-2xl`) alongside customIcon, so n_icon_box emits a real icon_color + icon_badge/badge_color instead of an inherit-dark, colourless icon. Colour resolution needs the semantic token map: set_style_config now enriches the mapper's Tailwind config with extract_semantic_colors() (recovers primary/secondary/foreground from the captured computed styles) — parity with mirror_design(). Badge-color guard relaxed to accept rgb()/rgba(). JS twin (capture-extract cardNode) already read these live via getComputedStyle. Guarded by golden test [8] (per-card green/amber/green + icon-less negative control).

P0 band-fill FIX: the CTA's full-bleed `absolute inset-0 bg-primary` green (rgb(33,196,93)) now lands on the section's NATIVE background as `variant:alt` (the built green Section Style preset), instead of surviving only via a style.css class rule. So a converted CTA band renders its green from a section OPTION the user can see/edit. Content assembly (heading/text/button) is still PARTIAL (no native call_to_action).

P1 fidelity fix (audit: 'body buttons emit empty style/state/size though button_colors + button_sizes presets exist'). A converted BODY button now attaches the matching Color + Size PRESET slug (style=btn-{color}, size=btn-{size}) — the SAME linking the header CTA does — via the shared Mapper::button_preset_for() (set from Stitch::build_button_presets by Mapper::set_button_presets). Strategy: the SEMANTIC fill class (bg-primary/btn-primary -> the Primary preset, bg-secondary -> Secondary, bg-white/bg-surface+border -> Outline), else matching the button's computed bg/text/border colours to a built preset within tolerance; size from an explicit btn-lg/md/sm class, else the computed font-size + padding matched to a size preset. The preset is ADDITIVE — the exact per-node fill/padding still rides on the compiled `.sc-btn-*` css_class safety net. On FreshPaws: green bg-primary -> btn-primary+btn-md, white+border -> btn-outline+btn-md, amber bg-secondary (largest) -> btn-secondary+btn-lg. TIGHT: a bare text-link (no fill/border) gets NO bogus preset. Guarded by golden test [11] (three body buttons + a bare-link negative control). PHP<->JS parity: to-pages.mjs buttonBlockNode via _buttonPresetFor (presets threaded through opts.buttonPresets from capture.mjs / buildButtonPresets).

P0 fidelity fix (audit: 'hero right column lands as one code_block'). A 'photo in an organic frame + floating badge + blob backdrop' composite now DECOMPOSES into NATIVE, editable elements instead of one ~1419-char verbatim code_block: (1) the IMAGE → a media_image whose organic border-radius (blob-shape-2: `60% 40% 30% 70% / 60% 30% 70% 40%`), white `border:8px solid`, and shadow-2xl ride on the node's scoped Custom CSS (`selector img{…}`); (2) each floating CARD/BADGE → an editable icon_box (icon chip → icon_badge + badge_color, bold title, muted subtitle) positioned/skinned over the image via scoped CSS (`selector{position:absolute;top:…;left:…;bg;radius;shadow;padding}`); (3) the decorative BLOB layer is reproduced as `selector::before` behind the image (organic radius + `bg rgba(33,196,93,.2)` + scale) — NO residual code_block for the blob. TIGHT guard (is_decomposable_image_composite): exactly ONE plus ≥1 ABSOLUTE overlay that is a content-bearing card/badge (skin present) and/or a decorative blob; a plain image + caption, or a non-card caption overlay, is NOT force-decomposed and falls back to the existing verbatim code_block. Hooked in BOTH paths: the image_overlay recognizer (single-column / decomposable cells) AND layout_cols (the media-only hero column that isn't cell_is_decomposable). PHP↔JS parity: capture-extract imgCompositeOf/floatingCardOf + to-pages mediaImageNode(blob/border)+floatingCardNode. Guarded by golden test [10] (composite → media_image+icon_box with the organic radius/border/shadow in CSS + the badge title editable; plain-image + non-card-overlay negative controls) and the FreshPaws hero baseline (now media_image+icon_box). Residual: the avatar RATING cluster beside the image stays its own small code_block (a different element).

TIGHT match (is_avatar_group): a compact wrapper of >=2 overlapping round profile (negative-margin/-space-x stack), no heading, short caption → the native `avatar` GROUP element (people + `+N` extra, bordered/circle/40px/35% overlap); the rating/label rides alongside as a small code block. Priority 84 sits above layout_row(82)/logo_strip(25) so the stack is claimed before it can be split into a generic 2-col row, but the tight wrapper test keeps a hero text+CTA column from being swallowed. WIRING VERIFIED (fidelity-audit P0): the hero column is decomposed via layout_cols -> collect_blocks, which offers each child wrapper to the recognizer registry, so the nested avatar wrapper reaches avatar_group before any code_block fallback — the stale pages-PHP-after.json code_block no longer reproduces. Guarded by golden test [2] (hero avatar) + [8] (synthetic hero band positive + plain-image-row negative control).

TIGHT match (is_counter_grid): >=2 cells AND every substantial cell is a numeric stat (counter_cell_parse: number + short <=32ch label, optional +/%/k prefix/suffix); bails if the band contains details/summary/table/ul/ol. Priority 91 = below testimonials(92), above card_grid(90). Feeds the previously-ORPHAN n_counter via the existing columns->counter cell path. Guarded by golden test [6].
TIGHT match (is_accordion_group): >=2 <details><summary> items OR >=2 [aria-expanded] toggles. Each item -> a `tabs` row {tab_title,tab_content,is_open:no}. Guarded by golden test [6].
Tag-scoped match (`table` with >=1 row) -> canonical {header_options(tabular),cols,rows,content}; leading all-<th> rows -> header_rows (<thead>). Guarded by golden test [6].

TIGHT match (is_text_list): real <ul>/<ol> with >=2 non-empty <li>, excludes nav/menu/tabs/pagination/breadcrumb by class/role/ancestor<nav>. <ul> -> design:check, <ol> -> design:numbered. Guarded by golden test [6].

TIGHT match (is_tabs_widget): a tablist ([role=tablist]+>=2 [role=tab], or .tabs/.nav-tabs + [data-tab]/aria-controls labels) where >=2 tabs each RESOLVE to a panel ([role=tabpanel], aria-controls→getElementById, or .tab-pane/[data-tab-content]). Each tab → a `tabs` row {tab_title,tab_content,is_active}. Rejects a plain <ul> nav (no tabs/panels) and an accordion (>=2 <details>). Priority 95 (above card_grid 90) is safe because the match is structural. Guarded by golden test [7] + a nav-list negative control.

TIGHT match (is_steps_flow): >=2 children each with a title AND (a .steps/.process class signal OR every child carries a numeric step marker — leading 'Step N'/'N' or a .step-number/.circle). Tie-break vs counter(91): a step card's title+prose fails counter_cell_parse (label>32), so counter never claims it; steps sits at 98 to win over card_grid(90). Each child → a step {title,content,number}. Guarded by golden test [7] + a feature-grid negative control.

TIGHT match (is_timeline): >=2 children each with a title AND a DATE token (<time>, a 19xx/20xx year, 'Mon YYYY', or MM/YYYY) — required on every entry unless the container carries a .timeline class. Tie-break vs steps(98, higher): steps keys off .steps/.process + numbers, timeline off dates, so the two don't overlap. Each entry → a milestone {date,title,text,…}. Guarded by golden test [7] + an undated-cards negative control.

TIGHT match (is_progress_bars): >=2 items where EVERY item has a STRUCTURAL bar percent — [role=progressbar][aria-valuenow] or an inner element with inline width:NN% (a .bar/.fill/etc.). Text-only 'NN%' is deliberately EXCLUDED so a stat grid ('98% Satisfaction') stays counters — priority 96 sits above counter_grid(91) but the structural-bar requirement is what actually separates them. Each item → a bar {label,percent}. Guarded by golden test [7] + a text-only-stat negative control.

TIGHT match (is_pricing_table): >=2 plan columns AND a price token (currency [$€£¥₹] + number) in MOST columns (>=ceil(0.6·n)). The required price token is what keeps a generic feature card_grid from being claimed. Priority 99 (above testimonials 92 / card_grid 90) so a real pricing band wins. Each column → a plan {plan_title, currency, price:{monthly,yearly}, period, features (one/line), featured, ribbon, button_*}. Guarded by golden test [7] + a no-price feature-grid negative control.

sections_body.detector: Stitch::section_id / Mapper::auto_id (source id attribute FIRST -> slug_from_id, then class/comment, then section-N)
sections_body.note: P0 FIX (audit sec 3): section_id()/auto_id() now read $node->getAttribute('id') first so in-page anchors/scroll-spy survive. Guarded by golden test (css_ids hero/features/cta).

sections_body.detector: sectionCs / sectionLayers (own bg + full-bleed `absolute inset-0 bg-*` layer)
sections_body.builder: n_section -> section NATIVE background: variant preset-link when the fill matches a built Section Style, else background.color.custom (gradient -> background.gradient stops)
sections_body.note: P0 FIX (audit: 'section band fills not applied'). The detected band fill is now emitted onto the section's OWN background option, not only style.css: n_section links `variant` to the matching section_style_preset slug (CTA green rgb(33,196,93) -> `alt`; hero tint rgb(247,253,249) -> `light`; white -> `light-2`) within a per-channel tolerance, else sets background.color.custom directly (never double-applied). Presets are fed to the mapper via Mapper::set_section_presets(build_section_style_presets(html)). JS parity in to-pages.mjs (applyBandFill + sectionStyles). Guarded by golden test [9] (hero/features/cta variants + no-fill + unmatched-custom-bg controls).

presets.note: Per-card icon chips now captured on the deterministic path: card_from_cell reads the icon's chip wrapper (iconChipCls) and n_icon_box derives icon_badge (shape from radius) + badge_color (fill) from it. Standalone library-level icon_badge_presets clustering remains limited.

Built presets are now LINKED from sections: Mapper::set_section_presets() feeds them to n_section, which sets a section's `variant` to the preset slug whose fill matches the detected band (P0 'band fills applied'). Previously every section emitted variant:'' and the presets were orphaned.

presets.detector: Stitch::table_block captures header/table data-sc-cs + zebra detection
presets.note: When a <table> is recognized, its captured styling (first <th> data-sc-cs header fill, table border, >=2 distinct <tr> backgrounds = striped) selects the best-matching EXISTING Table Preset from Theme Settings → Components → Tables by name keyword (striped→strip/zebra, filled header→border/grid/dark/modern, else the first/default), and n_table points `table_preset` at that slug. Uses the built-in preset library rather than emitting a bespoke per-table preset (that cross-phase derive+emit is a documented follow-up); the native table now carries a real skin instead of none. Guarded by golden test [7] (styled table → non-empty table_preset).

other.note: collect_blocks stamps each block (and flattened wrapper's) source animation INTENT: data-aos=fade-up/zoom-in/…, animate__* / wow classes, or a directional data-scroll/data-animate/data-reveal → an animate.css effect. apply_block_anim enables it on the node ONLY for the standard {enable,yes:{effect}} animation shape (text/heading/button/image/counter/testimonials/etc. — the vocabulary def_animation already uses); the interactive widgets (tabs/steps/…) use a different multi-picker {effect} whose valid slugs come from the animation-engine registry, so they're LEFT at their safe default (no invalid value written). No signal → stays disabled (no false motion). Guarded by golden test [7] (data-aos=fade-up → enabled fadeInUp + a no-attribute negative control).

Lottie: <lottie-player>/<dotlottie-player>, or a container with a .json/.lottie src / bodymovin init → `lottie` (source:url, viewport trigger; src carried). SVG-draw: an inline <svg> with stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset paths, or a draw class/data-draw flag → `svg_draw` (source:code, view trigger; markup carried, scripts/handlers stripped). TIGHT: a real embed/draw signal, never a plain decorative icon <svg>. Guarded by golden test [7] + a decorative-icon negative control. NOTE: Rive has NO native shortcode in the shortcodes extension, so a `.riv`/rive-runtime embed is deliberately left to the code_block fallback (nothing to map to) — see PARTIAL.

PARTIAL: Image + overlay: decomposed to media_image + icon_box (MAPPED); only the adjacent avatar-rating cluster stays a small code_block by design
Spacing / gap scale presets (not always distilled)
Table presets (points at the best-matching EXISTING preset by captured styling; bespoke per-table derive+emit of a NEW preset into theme-settings is a follow-up)

Animations / scroll motion (enabled on standard {enable,yes} elements; the interactive-widget multi-picker {effect} shape is left at its default — its valid effect slugs come from the animation-engine registry)
Rive embeds (no native `rive` shortcode exists in the shortcodes extension → left to the code_block fallback; Lottie + SVG-draw ARE mapped)
